title: Warning and Reminding
goal: Report a warning or a reminder, as a fact with the indicative and as an instruction with the subjunctive.
grammar: Warning and reminding: advertir, recordar, alertar

items: I can report a warning or a reminder of a fact with advertir or recordar + que + indicative.
I can report a warning or a reminder to do something with advertir or recordar + que + subjunctive.
I can use the new words for alerting and reminding.
